picks.title: AI-Generated Draft Response Tool, Message Turnaround Time, and After-Hours Replies Among Health Care Professionals
picks.take: Researchers test whether AI-drafted inbox replies cut turnaround time and after-hours work. Finally, an AI metric measured in physicians' evenings rather than the vendor's quarterly earnings.

picks.title: Hospitals write off $132B as AI fails to move the needle with finances
picks.take: Hospitals write off $132 billion while AI fails to move the needle on finances. The pilot budget was apparently the only thing that scaled.

picks.title: As more doctors consult chatbots, health systems can block them — or buy in
picks.take: Hundreds of thousands of doctors are consulting chatbots, so health systems must choose between blocking them and buying in. Either way, the curbside consult now has a data-sharing agreement.

picks.title: Why the latest heart drug failures should make us all more skeptical of AI hype
picks.take: Another round of heart drug failures suggests AI has not yet abolished the oldest bottleneck in drug development, which is biology. The pitch decks remain undefeated.

picks.title: Updated AI and/or Machine Learning-Based Medical Devices Cleared Through the FDA 510(k) Pathway
picks.take: JAMA Network Open updates the count of AI devices cleared through the FDA's 510(k) pathway. Substantial equivalence remains the only field where being similar to the last thing counts as innovation.

picks.title: AI: ChatGPT makers are sued by parents over daughter's death
picks.take: Parents sue ChatGPT's makers over their daughter's death. Courts may now decide what software companies have long avoided: whether a product that talks like a confidant owes a duty like one.

picks.title: More AI won’t fix healthcare’s revenue cycle. Orchestration will.
picks.take: Most providers automate revenue with AI, but only 4% have connected it. The proposed fix for too many disconnected tools is a tool to manage the tools.

picks.title: Performance of artificial intelligence versus clinician left-ventricular segmentation of cardiac MRI for mortality prediction: a retrospective, multicentre, prognostic study
picks.take: A multicentre study compares AI and clinician left-ventricular segmentation of cardiac MRI for predicting mortality. Radiologists have long suspected that contouring ventricles by hand was not the best use of a medical degree.

picks.title: Context is built, not given: context readiness as the next benchmark for clinical use of artificial intelligence
picks.take: The Lancet Digital Health argues that context readiness should be the next benchmark for clinical AI. The model passed the exam but has never seen our EHR, our workflow, or our Tuesday.

picks.title: FDA, CMS look to collaborate with states on health AI
picks.take: FDA and CMS want to work with states on health AI regulation, including protecting doctors from AI liability. Federal and state oversight will meet in the middle, probably at the physician's malpractice policy.
